notes: §1985:VI.3.4.2 prints the paragraph as the header DATE-COMPILED with its period, then any number of comment-entries. At 85 the paragraph is accepted (VersionConformancePass.VisitDateCompiledParagraph refuses it only from 2002, COBOL0902); the fixed-form logical conversion takes an Area-A DATE-COMPILED word in an Identification Division as the paragraph header and discards the entry, the grammar rule dateCompiledParagraph parses what is left, and ClosedFormatPass.ScreenClauseRepetition refuses a second DATE-COMPILED paragraph (COBOL2423) and one written after SECURITY (COBOL2987). The header's period is asked of the source by the one converter every comment-entry paragraph passes (kb/Work PB5168): a DATE-COMPILED with no separator period after it is COBOL7166.

next.reason: 1985: "DATE-COMPILED. [ comment-entry ] …"; 2023: "no 2023 clause holds the DATE-COMPILED paragraph; candidates cover other paragraphs only". No 2023 clause holds the DATE-COMPILED paragraph, and no candidate covers it; the candidates are other paragraphs, so 2023 lacks the feature.
